faq.q: Do I need an appointment at Frank's Clothier?
faq.a: The site says to schedule a one-on-one appointment for custom suits, tuxedos, alterations, casual wear, and rentals.
The site lists Saturday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Sunday is closed. Weekdays are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

faq.a: Phone (813) 286-7670 and email Valentin@franksclothier.com, at 4343 West Kennedy Blvd.
